# A01-S16 — Correspondence

Source extract. [████] marks omissions.

[████] Regardless of how it ends, there is a good story in MindFuture: about art in the age of technocapitalism – the dream of the UN, [████]. I could really get something out of that.

[████]

[████] I have said that we got far with a project proposal, but that we must have a meeting before we could proceed. At present, we can only suggest something to a defunct or a potential organization. A client is missing :-)

[████]

[████] There is still a lot of grant money in MindFuture’s idea of mixing art, tech, and business. The mission just has to be made concrete. One could easily get funded an exhibition space, a book series, a publishing house, a think tank, a school for digital literature ... [████]
